mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_job_run (job_name, started_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{jobName}, #{startedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{startedAt})
INSERT INTO batch_step_run (job_run_id, step_name, started_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{jobRunId}, #{stepName}, #{startedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_step_run SET finished_at = #{finishedAt}, result = #{result}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, summary = #{summary}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, window_end_date = #{windowEndDate}, collect_base_date = #{collectBaseDate}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(collect_base_date, DATE(started_at)) AS success_date, window_end_date FROM batch_step_run WHERE step_name = 'S1' AND result = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT result, collect_base_date FROM batch_step_run WHERE step_name = 'S1' AND job_run_id < #{jobRunId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT step_name, error_message FROM batch_step_run WHERE job_run_id = #{jobRunId} AND result = 'FAILURE' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
